description: This file defines various enums and data structures related to the icon state representation in a SwiftUI application, particularly differentiating activity states, roles, and icon overrides for UI elements.

methods.name: badgeSymbolName
methods.description: Returns the symbol name corresponding to the current activity state for UI icon display.

methods.name: badgeProminence
methods.description: Returns the prominence level of the badge, such as primary or secondary, based on activity state.

methods.name: isWorking
methods.description: Indicates whether the current icon state represents an active or working state.

methods.name: toIconState
methods.description: Converts an IconOverrideSelection case to an appropriate IconState.
